name: Plant Growth

targets.description: Overgrowth: plants in a 100-foot-radius Sphere; Enrichment (8-hour casting): plants within half a mile

summary: Overgrowth makes a 100-foot-radius area cost 4 ft of movement per foot; or enrich crops for a year (8-hour casting).
text: You pour vitality into plants, with one of two effects depending on how long you take to cast it. Overgrowth (an action): choose a point within range. Every ordinary plant in a 100-foot-radius Sphere centered there becomes thick and tangled, and a creature moving through the area must spend 4 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves. You can leave parts of the area of any size unaffected. Enrichment (8 hours): every plant within a half-mile radius of a point within range is enriched for 365 days and yields twice the usual amount of food when harvested; a plant can benefit from only one Plant Growth each year.
